country.name: Thailand
country.note: Apply-time prerequisite: geo.countries must include TH and pricing.currencies must include THB (not present in default seed.sql as of this dataset).

destination.name: Koh Phi Phi
destination.type_note: Editorial type only — catalog.destinations has no destination_type column; not imported as a typed enum.
destination.parent_note: Editorial parent label. Import format does not set parent_id; countryCode TH is required at apply time.
destination.summary_en: Andaman island group centred on Phi Phi Don’s Tonsai/Ao Lo Dalam hub, with Maya Bay day visits — lodging here is not the same as Krabi mainland or Phuket.
destination.summary_ar: مجموعة جزر أندامان حول مركز تونساي/آو لو دالام في في في دون، مع زيارات لمايا باي — الإقامة هنا ليست كرابي البرية ولا بوكيت.

geography_note: Tonsai village, Ao Lo Dalam, Long Beach, and viewpoint trails are short distances but boat-dependent to the mainland. Maya Bay is typically a regulated day visit, not a hotel base. Do not merge with Krabi or Phuket destination inventories.

integrity.accommodation_import: Only accommodationType mapped; starRating and amenities omitted until verified
